notes.title: V127
notes.notes:
I've uploaded V127 with the following changes:

- Block the staking of a tile that has already been staked.

- Number one player request: stop surprising player with the direction of the bridge. Now, the bridge directions are indicated before the bridge is staked out.

Note: I've upgraded my build machine to windows 10. So this is the first build that was made on that architecture. This should not make any difference for the build, but if it somehow mangled the game, let me know in the forums or via email to b.stolk@gmail.com

Thank you.

Bram Stolk

notes.title: V126
notes.notes:
I just released V126 with the following changes:

Fixed a freeze bug when path finding would freeze on jumbo planets if really long paths (>256 tiles) were found.

Seeing that people playing the Jumbo sized planets are my paying customers, I feel really bad for the fact that the jumbo planet was less stable than the normal size. 

Hopefully, playing jumbo size is now as stable as the large size.

My thanks go out to Mr Woodchuck for helping me track down the issue.

notes.title: V113 with fix for launch crash.
notes.notes:
I've uploaded a new version of the game: V113.
It contains the following fixes:

- Fix for launch crash that many windows users were experiencing.
- Music played from memory, instead of non stop streaming from disk.

Known issues:
- Music keeps playing in menu.

If you had launch issues with the game, please try the update and report back. You may have to restart the steam client to have it pick up the update.

notes.title: Update V110
notes.notes:
I just released V110 on the store.
Changelog:


V110
====

Increased tree limit and increased item limit, so that Jumbo worlds don't hit it.

Annotate storage areas that are full.


V109
====

This release fixes an issue where Orcs could get stranded just off a bridge. 

It also fixes a bug where after loading a saved game, Orcs would not resume the construction of a bridge. 

Older fixes include disabling floating-point-exceptions on Linux to work around a Mesa bug[lists.freedesktop.org] that plagued the driver for Intel's integrated GPU. 

Another older fix is an added line for Gaia the tutor.

Older fixes include disabling floating-point-exceptions on Linux to work around a [url=https://lists.freedesktop.org/archives/mesa-dev/2016-September/127961.html]Mesa bug[/url] that plagued the driver for Intel's integrated GPU.

Another older fix is an added line for Gaia the tutor.

Thank you for playing my game. Please discuss issues and ideas on the forum. Your input is a big help.
